name: uk-compliance-2025
display_name: UK Compliance 2025 — ECCTA, Online Safety, DUAA, Consumer Duty, OFSI
description: Structured knowledge graph for the 2025 wave of UK compliance regimes: Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 (failure-to-prevent-fraud live 1 Sept 2025), Online Safety Act 2023 (illegal-harms duties live 17 Mar 2025), Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (main reforms 5 Feb 2026), FCA Consumer Duty (PRIN 2A), SAMLA 2018 / OFSI sanctions enforcement, plus cross-references to the UK Bribery Act 2010, MLR 2017, POCA 2002, Fraud Act 2006, and FSMA 2000.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
